deck_title: Feline 16x anisotropic minor-axis mipmap footprint vs naive isotropic max-derivative grazing blur rig

cards.subtitle: Deterministic McCormack et al. (SIGGRAPH 1999 Feline) & Heckbert (1986) closed-form Jacobian SVD minor-axis mipmap selection (sigma_minor^2 = 0.5*(E + G - sqrt((E-G)^2 + 4F^2)), clamping sigma_eff = max(sigma_minor, sigma_major / 16) to lock transverse footprint ratio B = 1.0000x and 0.00 mip overblur across all 17 grazing anisotropy stations A in [1, 16]) versus naive isotropic trilinear mipmapping (selecting mip level from sigma_major = A, which inflates transverse footprint by A up to 16.0000x / +4.0000 mip levels across 16/17 stations) and 64-angle polar harmonic footprint integration.
